frame.treatment: Continuous even flat golden-yellow frame, no bevel or shadow

factual_anchors: This is an original imaginary editorial concept, not a named real location or an archival photograph
Only the scene and exact text specified for this example
allowed_changes: Compose the new original scene and adjust crop/light to achieve the specified cover
Optically refine text within its designated zone while retaining exact characters
forbidden_changes: Recognizable famous landmarks or named real buildings
People, vehicles, flags or animals unless explicitly requested
Extra text, fake captions, barcodes, dates, numbers, logos
Detached rectangular title panels or decorative geometric mountains
review_checks: One immediate visual focus at 200px wide
Exact Chinese characters and intended line order
Source image retains tangible photographic depth/material
Masthead and headline have different functions and strong local contrast
No accidental collision of text and important subject features
content_promise: 由檐口的形态与木石材质引导读者进入建筑专题，示范斜向形态与局部字场。

direction.why_this_image: A deep roof eave creates a strong diagonal; a quiet warm plaster wall gives the headline a credible photographic surface.
direction.rejected_route: symmetrical frontal postcard of an entire temple
direction.why_rejected: It would reduce material detail and force both titles into a small sky strip.

art_direction.subject: An original imagined Chinese timber courtyard building, deep tiled overhang, weathered red-brown beams and a pale lime-plaster wall; not any identifiable historic temple.
art_direction.camera: Low oblique close-up, 50mm architectural perspective, look beneath an eave; no extreme wide-angle distortion.
art_direction.subject_scale: Eave and timber fill upper/left 65%; naturally quiet pale wall extends down right for title.
art_direction.foreground: A sharply resolved timber column near left edge, stopping short of masthead.
art_direction.middle_ground: Repeated tile ends and layered eaves run diagonally from upper right toward left middle; visible credible joints.
art_direction.background: Warm pale lime-plaster wall on right/lower area; small shadowed courtyard glimpse, no invented statues.
art_direction.eye_path: Masthead in deep upper shadow -> diagonal roof edge -> red topic on pale wall -> lower timber grain.
art_direction.light: Soft reflected daylight with a narrow warm grazing beam revealing tile and wood texture.
art_direction.palette: Charcoal tile, aged timber red-brown, warm ivory wall, brick-red topic letters; restrained gold frame.
art_direction.texture: Tactile photographic timber grain, subtle chipped plaster and ceramic tile, natural wear, no illustration flattening.

text.font_character: Substantial white Song serif masthead, optically spaced and visually independent of headline.
text.contrast_plan: Reserve a contiguous deep shadow/wood region behind the entire masthead.

text.font_character: Large brick-red Song/Mincho serif with architectural firmness, two carefully aligned lines.
text.contrast_plan: Dark brick-red characters on naturally pale quiet plaster; no separate title card.
